_: From FTB Infinity's census (W4 T13 judged, T14 corrected, 2026-11-08). GravelOre is an ore seam set in gravel, every value of it, and is built on the game's sand class, which the rules take as sand; a road worn across a seam should wear the ground around it, so it stands aside.
Value 5 of CraftedSoil is Slimy Mud by the mod's own words, the bare earth of a slime island; the soil in the name reads as worked ground to the rules, which stays right for its other values.
